phoneticConvention: Approximate respelling for English readers (CAPITALS = stressed syllable; vowels ah / eh / ee / oh / oo; c+e/i → ch, g+e/i → j, gn → ny, gl → ly, sc+e/i → sh, z → ts / dz; double consonants held longer, e.g. kaf-FEH). No substitute for the audio.
reviewStatus: Written by rule from validated content; native English review recommended.
title: Explaining and comparing
goal: Explain a reason, compare and express a preference.

model.note: "stanco" for a man, "stanca" for a woman.

variants.study: Non vengo perché sono stanco.
variants.phon: nohn VEHN-goh pehr-KEH SOH-noh STAHN-koh
variants.native: I'm not coming because I'm tired.

variants.study: Non vengo perché devo lavorare.
variants.phon: nohn VEHN-goh pehr-KEH DEH-voh lah-voh-RAH-reh
variants.native: I'm not coming because I have to work.

variants.study: Non vengo perché ho un appuntamento.
variants.phon: nohn VEHN-goh pehr-KEH oh oon ahp-poon-tah-MEHN-toh
variants.native: I'm not coming because I have an appointment.

variants.study: Non vengo perché non sto bene.
variants.phon: nohn VEHN-goh pehr-KEH nohn stoh BEH-neh
variants.native: I'm not coming because I'm not feeling well.

model.study: Il treno è più {s} della macchina.
model.phon: eel TREH-noh eh pyoo {s} DEHL-lah MAHK-kee-nah
model.native: The train is {s} than the car.

variants.study: Il treno è più veloce della macchina.
variants.phon: eel TREH-noh eh pyoo veh-LOH-cheh DEHL-lah MAHK-kee-nah
variants.native: The train is faster than the car.

variants.study: Il treno è più comodo della macchina.
variants.phon: eel TREH-noh eh pyoo KOH-moh-doh DEHL-lah MAHK-kee-nah
variants.native: The train is more comfortable than the car.

variants.study: Il treno è più caro della macchina.
variants.phon: eel TREH-noh eh pyoo KAH-roh DEHL-lah MAHK-kee-nah
variants.native: The train is more expensive than the car.

variants.study: Il treno è più ecologico della macchina.
variants.phon: eel TREH-noh eh pyoo eh-koh-LOH-jee-koh DEHL-lah MAHK-kee-nah
variants.native: The train is greener than the car.

model.native: This one is less {s} than that one.

variants.study: Questo è meno caro di quello.
variants.phon: KWEHS-toh eh MEH-noh KAH-roh dee KWEHL-loh
variants.native: This one is less expensive than that one.

variants.study: Questo è meno grande di quello.
variants.phon: KWEHS-toh eh MEH-noh GRAHN-deh dee KWEHL-loh
variants.native: This one is smaller than that one.

variants.study: Questo è meno pesante di quello.
variants.phon: KWEHS-toh eh MEH-noh peh-ZAHN-teh dee KWEHL-loh
variants.native: This one is lighter than that one.

variants.study: Questo è meno bello di quello.
variants.phon: KWEHS-toh eh MEH-noh BEHL-loh dee KWEHL-loh
variants.native: This one isn't as nice as that one.

model.native: I prefer {s} because it costs less.

variants.study: Preferisco il treno perché costa meno.
variants.phon: preh-feh-REES-koh eel TREH-noh pehr-KEH KOHS-tah MEH-noh
variants.native: I prefer the train because it costs less.

variants.study: Preferisco il mercato perché costa meno.
variants.phon: preh-feh-REES-koh eel mehr-KAH-toh pehr-KEH KOHS-tah MEH-noh
variants.native: I prefer the market because it costs less.

variants.study: Preferisco cucinare a casa perché costa meno.
variants.phon: preh-feh-REES-koh koo-chee-NAH-reh ah KAH-zah pehr-KEH KOHS-tah MEH-noh
variants.native: I prefer cooking at home because it costs less.

variants.study: Preferisco l'autobus perché costa meno.
variants.phon: preh-feh-REES-koh LOW-toh-boos pehr-KEH KOHS-tah MEH-noh
variants.native: I prefer the bus because it costs less.

model.note: After "penso che", Italian uses the subjunctive (sia, abbia).

variants.study: Penso che sia una buona idea.
variants.phon: PEHN-soh keh SEE-ah OO-nah BWOH-nah ee-DEH-ah
variants.native: I think it's a good idea.

variants.study: Penso che sia troppo caro.
variants.phon: PEHN-soh keh SEE-ah TROHP-poh KAH-roh
variants.native: I think it's too expensive.

variants.study: Penso che tu abbia ragione.
variants.phon: PEHN-soh keh too AHB-byah rah-JOH-neh
variants.native: I think you're right.

variants.study: Penso che sia meglio aspettare.
variants.phon: PEHN-soh keh SEE-ah MEH-lyoh ahs-peht-TAH-reh
variants.native: I think it's better to wait.

units.situation: Giving an opinion: in my opinion

variants.study: Secondo me, è troppo caro.
variants.phon: seh-KOHN-doh meh, eh TROHP-poh KAH-roh
variants.native: In my opinion, it's too expensive.

variants.study: Secondo me, questo ristorante è migliore.
variants.phon: seh-KOHN-doh meh, KWEHS-toh rees-toh-RAHN-teh eh mee-LYOH-reh
variants.native: In my opinion, this restaurant is better.

slot.study: il vino rosso è più buono
slot.phon: eel VEE-noh ROHS-soh eh pyoo BWOH-noh

variants.study: Secondo me, il vino rosso è più buono.
variants.phon: seh-KOHN-doh meh, eel VEE-noh ROHS-soh eh pyoo BWOH-noh
variants.native: In my opinion, the red wine is nicer.

variants.study: Secondo me, è una buona idea.
variants.phon: seh-KOHN-doh meh, eh OO-nah BWOH-nah ee-DEH-ah
variants.native: In my opinion, it's a good idea.

slot.native: I used to work in an office

variants.study: Prima lavoravo in ufficio, adesso lavoro da casa.
variants.phon: PREE-mah lah-voh-RAH-voh een oof-FEE-choh, ah-DEHS-soh lah-VOH-roh dah KAH-zah
variants.native: I used to work in an office, now I work from home.

slot.native: I used to take the train every day

variants.study: Prima prendevo il treno ogni giorno, adesso lavoro da casa.
variants.phon: PREE-mah prehn-DEH-voh eel TREH-noh OH-nyee JOR-noh, ah-DEHS-soh lah-VOH-roh dah KAH-zah
variants.native: I used to take the train every day, now I work from home.

slot.native: I used to go to the office every day

variants.study: Prima andavo in ufficio ogni giorno, adesso lavoro da casa.
variants.phon: PREE-mah ahn-DAH-voh een oof-FEE-choh OH-nyee JOR-noh, ah-DEHS-soh lah-VOH-roh dah KAH-zah
variants.native: I used to go to the office every day, now I work from home.

slot.native: I used to travel a lot

variants.study: Prima viaggiavo molto, adesso lavoro da casa.
variants.phon: PREE-mah vyahd-JAH-voh MOHL-toh, ah-DEHS-soh lah-VOH-roh dah KAH-zah
variants.native: I used to travel a lot, now I work from home.

variants.study: Lo compro perché è in offerta.
variants.phon: loh KOHM-proh pehr-KEH eh een ohf-FEHR-tah
variants.native: I'm buying it because it's on sale.

variants.study: Lo compro perché mi piace il colore.
variants.phon: loh KOHM-proh pehr-KEH mee PYAH-cheh eel koh-LOH-reh
variants.native: I'm buying it because I like the colour.

variants.study: Lo compro perché è di buona qualità.
variants.phon: loh KOHM-proh pehr-KEH eh dee BWOH-nah kwah-lee-TAH
variants.native: I'm buying it because it's good quality.

variants.study: Lo compro perché ne ho bisogno.
variants.phon: loh KOHM-proh pehr-KEH neh oh bee-ZOH-nyoh
variants.native: I'm buying it because I need it.

variants.study: Per me è troppo salato.
variants.phon: pehr MEH eh TROHP-poh sah-LAH-toh
variants.native: For me it's too salty.

variants.study: Per me è perfetto.
variants.phon: pehr MEH eh pehr-FEHT-toh
variants.native: For me it's perfect.

variants.study: Per me è un po' piccante.
variants.phon: pehr MEH eh oon poh peek-KAHN-teh
variants.native: For me it's a bit spicy.

variants.study: Per me è troppo dolce.
variants.phon: pehr MEH eh TROHP-poh DOHL-cheh
variants.native: For me it's too sweet.

variants.study: È grande come il mio.
variants.phon: eh GRAHN-deh KOH-meh eel MEE-oh
variants.native: It's as big as mine.

variants.study: È bello come il mio.
variants.phon: eh BEHL-loh KOH-meh eel MEE-oh
variants.native: It's as nice as mine.

variants.study: È caro come il mio.
variants.phon: eh KAH-roh KOH-meh eel MEE-oh
variants.native: It's as expensive as mine.

variants.study: È vecchio come il mio.
variants.phon: eh VEHK-kyoh KOH-meh eel MEE-oh
variants.native: It's as old as mine.

variants.study: È per questo che sono in ritardo.
variants.phon: eh pehr KWEHS-toh keh SOH-noh een ree-TAR-doh
variants.native: That's why I'm late.

variants.study: È per questo che ho cambiato lavoro.
variants.phon: eh pehr KWEHS-toh keh oh kahm-BYAH-toh lah-VOH-roh

variants.study: È per questo che non mangio carne.
variants.phon: eh pehr KWEHS-toh keh nohn MAHN-joh KAR-neh
variants.native: That's why I don't eat meat.

variants.study: È per questo che preferisco il treno.
variants.phon: eh pehr KWEHS-toh keh preh-feh-REES-koh eel TREH-noh
variants.native: That's why I prefer the train.

variants.study: Qual è la differenza tra questo e quello?
variants.phon: kwah-LEH lah deef-feh-REHN-tsah trah KWEHS-toh eh KWEHL-loh
variants.native: What's the difference between this one and that one?

variants.study: Qual è la differenza tra i due menù?
variants.phon: kwah-LEH lah deef-feh-REHN-tsah trah ee DOO-eh meh-NOO
variants.native: What's the difference between the two menus?

variants.study: Qual è la differenza tra il treno e l'autobus?
variants.phon: kwah-LEH lah deef-feh-REHN-tsah trah eel TREH-noh eh LOW-toh-boos
variants.native: What's the difference between the train and the bus?

variants.study: Qual è la differenza tra le due camere?
variants.phon: kwah-LEH lah deef-feh-REHN-tsah trah leh DOO-eh KAH-meh-reh
variants.native: What's the difference between the two rooms?

dialogues.situation: In a shop: choosing a jacket (Lei)

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Buongiorno, cerco una giacca. Qual è la differenza tra queste due?
turns.phon: bwohn-JOR-noh, CHEHR-koh OO-nah JAHK-kah. kwah-LEH lah deef-feh-REHN-tsah trah KWEHS-teh DOO-eh
turns.native: Hello, I'm looking for a jacket. What's the difference between these two?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Questa è di lana, quella è di cotone.
turns.phon: KWEHS-tah eh dee LAH-nah, KWEHL-lah eh dee koh-TOH-neh
turns.native: This one is wool, that one is cotton.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: E quale costa meno?
turns.phon: eh KWAH-leh KOHS-tah MEH-noh
turns.native: And which one costs less?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Quella di cotone è meno cara, ma la lana è più calda.
turns.phon: KWEHL-lah dee koh-TOH-neh eh MEH-noh KAH-rah, mah lah LAH-nah eh pyoo KAHL-dah
turns.native: The cotton one is cheaper, but wool is warmer.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Preferisco quella di lana perché fa freddo.
turns.phon: preh-feh-REES-koh KWEHL-lah dee LAH-nah pehr-KEH fah FREHD-doh
turns.native: I prefer the wool one because it's cold.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Secondo me è la scelta giusta. Che taglia porta?
turns.phon: seh-KOHN-doh meh eh lah SHEHL-tah JOOS-tah. keh TAH-lyah POR-tah
turns.native: In my opinion that's the right choice. What size are you?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: La media. Posso provarla?
turns.phon: lah MEH-dyah. POHS-soh proh-VAR-lah
turns.native: Medium. Can I try it on?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Certo, il camerino è là in fondo.
turns.phon: CHEHR-toh, eel kah-meh-REE-noh eh LAH een FOHN-doh
turns.native: Of course, the fitting room is at the back.

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

dialogues.situation: At the restaurant: what to have (friends, tu)

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Cosa prendi? Io penso che il pesce sia buonissimo qui.
turns.phon: KOH-zah PREHN-dee. EE-oh PEHN-soh keh eel PEH-sheh SEE-ah bwoh-NEES-see-moh KWEE
turns.native: What are you having? I think the fish is excellent here.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Secondo me la pasta è migliore, e costa meno.
turns.phon: seh-KOHN-doh meh lah PAHS-tah eh mee-LYOH-reh, eh KOHS-tah MEH-noh
turns.native: In my opinion the pasta is better, and it costs less.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: È vero, ma io non mangio pasta la sera.
turns.phon: eh VEH-roh, mah EE-oh nohn MAHN-joh PAHS-tah lah SEH-rah
turns.native: True, but I don't eat pasta in the evening.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Perché?
turns.phon: pehr-KEH
turns.native: Why?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Perché prima mangiavo troppo e dormivo male. Adesso mangio leggero.
turns.phon: pehr-KEH PREE-mah mahn-JAH-voh TROHP-poh eh dor-MEE-voh MAH-leh. ah-DEHS-soh MAHN-joh lehd-JEH-roh
turns.native: Because I used to eat too much and sleep badly. Now I eat light.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Capisco. Allora per te il pesce, per me la pasta.
turns.phon: kah-PEES-koh. ahl-LOH-rah pehr TEH eel PEH-sheh, pehr MEH lah PAHS-tah
turns.native: I see. So fish for you, pasta for me.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: E da bere? Il vino bianco è più leggero del rosso.
turns.phon: eh dah BEH-reh. eel VEE-noh BYAHN-koh eh pyoo lehd-JEH-roh dehl ROHS-soh
turns.native: And to drink? The white wine is lighter than the red.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Va bene, bianco.
turns.phon: vah BEH-neh, BYAHN-koh
turns.native: OK, white.

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Allora, perché hai cambiato casa?
turns.phon: ahl-LOH-rah, pehr-KEH AH-ee kahm-BYAH-toh KAH-zah
turns.native: So, why did you move house?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Perché prima abitavo in centro ed era troppo caro.
turns.phon: pehr-KEH PREE-mah ah-bee-TAH-voh een CHEHN-troh ehd EH-rah TROHP-poh KAH-roh
turns.native: Because I used to live in the centre and it was too expensive.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: E adesso dove abiti?
turns.phon: eh ah-DEHS-soh DOH-veh AH-bee-tee
turns.native: And where do you live now?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: In periferia. La casa è più grande e meno cara.
turns.phon: een peh-ree-feh-REE-ah. lah KAH-zah eh pyoo GRAHN-deh eh MEH-noh KAH-rah
turns.native: In the suburbs. The house is bigger and cheaper.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Ma è più lontano dal lavoro, no?
turns.phon: mah eh pyoo lohn-TAH-noh dahl lah-VOH-roh, noh
turns.native: But it's further from work, isn't it?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Sì, ma prendo il treno. È più comodo della macchina.
turns.phon: SEE, mah PREHN-doh eel TREH-noh. eh pyoo KOH-moh-doh DEHL-lah MAHK-kee-nah
turns.native: Yes, but I take the train. It's more comfortable than the car.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Penso che tu abbia ragione. Io preferisco il centro perché esco spesso.
turns.phon: PEHN-soh keh too AHB-byah rah-JOH-neh. EE-oh preh-feh-REES-koh eel CHEHN-troh pehr-KEH EHS-koh SPEHS-soh
turns.native: I think you're right. I prefer the centre because I go out a lot.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Capisco. Dipende dalla vita che fai.
turns.phon: kah-PEES-koh. dee-PEHN-deh DAHL-lah VEE-tah keh FAH-ee
turns.native: I see. It depends on the life you lead.

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

readiness: Give reasons with "perché", compare (più / meno / come), give a simple opinion (penso che, secondo me) and contrast a past habit with the present situation (prima… adesso…).
